knownAmbiguitiesOrLimitations: The SAI notification names Indian sports ecosystem and schemes as one A2 group but does not provide a separate A2 sample paper; the Annexure B four-option MCQ structure was used.

Khelo India operational guidelines describe the 2021–22 to 2025–26 revised period, while SAI's current portal also lists Khelo India Para Games. Questions distinguish the dated revised structure from current portal listings rather than treating them as identical lists.

The central source catalog has one broad sports-governance-official entry covering SAI and MYAS information. Granular source suggestions are included above; no shared catalog file was edited by this agent.
No volatile officeholder, athlete-count or award-amount question was included. This reduces the risk of stale current-affairs facts as of 2026-08-16.

questionsRecommendedForCentralReview.reason: Current SAI portal wording lists Khelo India Para Games alongside other national-level competitions; central review should retain the current portal interpretation if the application prefers the notification's narrower dated scheme wording.
Core and Development group descriptions can change with scheme administration; verify the wording against the latest SAI TOPS athlete documents before release.

Recognition lists are year-specific; the question intentionally asks about the publishing authority rather than a volatile federation membership fact, but the central reviewer should confirm the 2025 list remains the latest inspected list.

reviewNotes: All 40 objects use exactly four options, a zero-based correct index, the exact canonical topic, A2 section, and asOf 2026-08-16.
Correct answer positions are intentionally balanced at 10 per index. Options were written with parallel grammatical structure and without meaningless padding.
The bank uses 28 foundational and 12 applied questions, approximating the requested 70/30 foundational-to-applied mix.
Every explanation identifies the relevant scheme role, component or institutional function and is tied to the inspected official material listed above.
Option-length audit: 13 of 40 correct options are strictly longest (32.5%); maximum within-question option-length spread is 15 characters.
